statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) is indicated
The diagnosis codes are R55, G45.9, and R42
The claim was denied based on Reason Code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
